name: TriumphSubstation
title: Triumph Substations
author: Logvinov Alecksey
description:
Adds three new advanced substations to the game.
- Longer hook up range
- Bigger coverage
- More expensive
- Adds Electric Energy Distribution 3 research
* Advanced Substation
* Experimental Nucleonic Substation (Volatile)
* Reckless Substation

The Experimental Nucleonic Substation can be used with Roboports

Uses Quantum, temporal and rubber band science to allow the electricity to flow to such a large area. The rubber bands are to keep the wire tight.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!
